# Setting actions on a key: the setting is changed and kept, written into
# the config file in place as the command palette's own editing writes it,
# and every window follows the reload — the pane's text grows and shrinks.
# (`action:` can't carry a comma, so cycle_setting's own list isn't here;
# the unit tests have it.)
expect-font:13
action:increase_setting:font-size:3
wait:0.4
expect-font:16
action:decrease_setting:font-size
wait:0.4
expect-font:15
action:set_setting:font-size=18
wait:0.4
expect-font:18
# Back to the default: its line leaves the file.
action:reset_setting:font-size
wait:0.4
expect-font:13
# A number stops where its Settings control does (font size: 6 to 72).
action:increase_setting:font-size:200
wait:0.4
expect-font:72
action:reset_setting:font-size
wait:0.4
expect-font:13
# The palette offers the turn a switch can take now, found by the name
# Settings gives it; an empty palette lists none of them.
key:cmd+shift+p
expect-palette-not:Turn On
type:turn on copy on sel
expect-palette:Turn On Copy on selection
key:escape
